Description: Employee slipped on wet floor near printer area. No wet-floor sign had been placed.
RootCause: Housekeeping failure – wet floor not cordoned off
CorrectiveAction: Facilities management briefed. Wet-floor signs now mandatory. OHSA Section 8 compliance review done.

Description: Suspicious individuals attempted to case the branch. Security activated panic button. No injuries.
RootCause: CCTV blind spot at entrance; security guard position inadequate
CorrectiveAction: Additional CCTV cameras installed. Security guard rotation improved. SAPS case opened. OHSA s24 notification filed.

Location: Cape Town CBD Branch – Server Room
Description: Exposed wiring found behind server rack. Potential electrocution risk identified during routine inspection.
RootCause: Maintenance backlog – electrical inspection overdue by 6 months
CorrectiveAction: Electrical contractor engaged. Full rewiring scheduled. OHSA Section 9 employer duty fulfilled.
